Coram : A.K. SIKRI*, ASHOK BHUSHAN
Forest Act, 1927: A B s.41 - Levy of transit fee on forest produce by three States­ Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand and Madhya Pradesh - Validity of - C Notification dated 28.05.2001 prescribing fee for issuing pass for transit afforest produce - Held: Levy of transit fee is valid - Notification Stale of Madhya Pradesh cannot be said to be beyond the scope of 1: 5 of 2000 Rules and s. 41 of the 192 7 Act - State of Madhya Pradesh was D fully justified in fixing rate of transit fee at the rate of Rs. 71- and Rs.41- per tonne which was well within the power of the Stale ulr. 5 of 2000 Rules
Decision Date : 15-09-2017 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 14874/2017 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 2 Judges
